meta.title: Quick switcher
meta.description: A unified search surface that switches sessions, browses workspaces, creates a workspace from a directory path with =, runs application commands, refills the input from sent prompts and answers to the agent's questions, jumps to a main panel such as Plugins or Automation tasks, recovers archived sessions from ~, opens workspace files in the Sidebar from @, and answers a side question about the current session from ? or its fullwidth form ？ at either end. Settings can switch modules on or off and choose the default open mode; every mode also has a direct command in Edit shortcuts, unbound by default. Opens with Ctrl+Shift+K by default, and a side question carries the full tool activity and the running step, with its model and reasoning effort configurable and images and files configurable in Settings.
